title: Treder2021 hippocampal switchboard: epoched intracranial EEG during object/scene localiser and associative recall (extra-hippocampal channels)
description: Epoched intracranial EEG from 11 epilepsy patients (22 recordings, about 9 hours of epochs at 200 Hz) recorded during an object/scene localiser task and an associative recall task. The data are a BIDS-formatted derivative of the authors' OSF release accompanying a study of the hippocampus as a switchboard between perception and memory. Channels carry anonymised labels without coordinates and cover extra-hippocampal sites.
methods_description: FieldTrip epoch structures released on OSF were repackaged into BrainVision float32 files at 200 Hz, with trials written back-to-back and one New Segment marker per trial. Trial information fields were stored in events.tsv. Preprocessing is described in the original article.
